pool: First768 state from128 fresh baseline3ply games; shared fixed pool, no evaluation games; mixed25% episode starts from pool,75% normal openings. Reshuffle hidden deck on resume.
training: Existing two-ply score policy and TD(lambda), score reward unchanged, no teacher/anchor updates. alpha .008/.003/.001 at50%/85%CPU. Freeze1536+ stages. Final checkpoint only.
evaluation: unchanged MCTS1msCPU/move; same512 fresh seeds for baseline and6 models; stop1536/death
statistics: Two prespecified contrasts: ordinary-minus-base and mixed-minus-ordinary. Average training replicas within game seed, paired t intervals and Holm2 tests. Conditional on3 training seeds. Baseline run once.
promotion: No website change without stable gain and late-stage/browser validation
